scenario_description:
Objective: Get the indigo family rebozo returned in time for tonight's private supper viewing.
Emerging Need: The paid locker handoff begins at the Annex, then stops when the locker door traps the cedar sleeve and neither drop-off nor retrieval can continue.
Decision Context: Observable records show the receipt, fault, same-day clearance window, and overnight lockup path; stored textile-care notes supply handling limits not stated in the notices.
Consequence: Timely help could restore the same return attempt without unsafe handling; after the maintenance sweep, the rebozo remains unavailable until tomorrow.

parameter.title: Family rebozo supper at Tía Alma's rental
parameter.description: Quiet family supper with a short viewing of the indigo rebozo if Celia's return works today.
parameter.location: Alma's rental casita off Canyon Road

parameter.content: I have the cedar sleeve with your indigo rebozo and can take it to the Annex lockers at lunch. If you're still across town, I'll use the day-use handoff locker instead of keeping it in my car.

parameter.description: Day-use handoff locker H4 for Celia's rebozo return; access code issued to Maren.

parameter.content: I'm at the Annex locker bank now. H4 opened with the code and I slid the cedar sleeve in, but the roll-down door caught halfway and the sleeve is trapped. The keypad just flashes LOCK FAULT, so I can't finish the drop or retrieve it without forcing the door.

parameter.subject: Locker H4 fault receipt LOCKER-H4-0421
parameter.body: Our system logged a jam on H4 at 12:12 for receipt LOCKER-H4-0421. The maintenance runner can manually clear same-day locker faults until 12:40 today; after that, stuck contents are secured by facilities for next-business-day release. Please include handling constraints in any written note to the duty desk.

parameter.subject: Locker H4 secured for overnight release
parameter.body: The midday maintenance sweep closed at 12:40 with H4 still faulted. Contents have been sealed in facilities storage; the next supervised release window opens Wednesday 2026-04-22 at 09:00.
